mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the costs that have been recorded."
Historical costs refer to the costs that have been recorded.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-discount capital investment appraisal technique in that it does not take into consideration the time value of money involved."
ARR is a non-discount capital investment appraisal technique in that it does not take into consideration the time value of money involved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool for achieving the goals and objectives in the hands of a business manager."
Performance measurement is a tool for achieving the goals and objectives in the hands of a business manager.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the work content in an hour and not that of time involved or taken to produce."
A standard hour is a measure of the work content in an hour and not that of time involved or taken to produce.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the gross rate, before tax."
The rate quoted is the gross rate, before tax.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the important techniques of costing used for cost control and also for performance evaluation."
Budget and Budgetary Control is one of the important techniques of costing used for cost control and also for performance evaluation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a serious activity of management and some time should be expended on it."
Budget preparation is a serious activity of management and some time should be expended on it.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of collecting, recording, classifying, analysing, summarising, allocating and evaluating various alternative courses of action and control of costs."
Note that cost accounting is a process of collecting, recording, classifying, analysing, summarising, allocating and evaluating various alternative courses of action and control of costs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the budgeted quantities at standard hours specified multiplied by standard rate per hour."
Budgeted Fixed Overhead (BFO) is the budgeted quantities at standard hours specified multiplied by standard rate per hour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of analysing the total difference planned and actual performance into its components parts."
Variance analysis is the process of analysing the total difference planned and actual performance into its components parts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as 'the technique and process of ascertaining costs'."
Costing may be defined as 'the technique and process of ascertaining costs'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basis of all cost-volume-profit (C."
Knowledge of cost behaviour is the basis of all cost-volume-profit (C.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which can be controlled or influenced by a conscious management action."
Controllable costs are those which can be controlled or influenced by a conscious management action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which the long term corporate plan is converted into action or activities."
Budgeting or short term planning is the process by which the long term corporate plan is converted into action or activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as "a quantitative statement for a defined time which may include planned revenues, expenses, assets, liabilities and cash flow."
A budget is defined as "a quantitative statement for a defined time which may include planned revenues, expenses, assets, liabilities and cash flow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of measurement that gives top managers a fast but comprehensive view of the business."
Balance scorecard is a set of measurement that gives top managers a fast but comprehensive view of the business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of the magnitude of fixed overhead over- absorbed in the production process."
Fixed Cost Variance The fixed cost variance is a function of the magnitude of fixed overhead over- absorbed in the production process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a future cost which is different for different alternatives."
Relevant cost is a future cost which is different for different alternatives.

PPBS is the counter part of the long-term process for profit-oriented organisations.
